new_scholarship.description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters are high-level, integrated transnational study programmes at master's level designed and delivered by international partnerships of higher education institutions. An EMJM involves at least three higher education institutions from at least three different countries, and includes periods of study, research, traineeship, thesis preparation and defence. Each edition runs 1 to 2 academic years (60, 90 or 120 ECTS credits) and awards either a joint degree or multiple degrees. A new batch of selected Erasmus Mundus Masters is added to the list each year, and students apply directly to the institution running their chosen programme.

new_scholarship.official_source: Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR), Government of India
new_scholarship.description: The Suborno Jayanti Scholarship Scheme is the ICCR scheme for nationals of Bangladesh, subsuming the earlier Bangladesh schemes previously offered by ICCR. Under it, the Government of India through ICCR provides scholarship at UG, PG and Ph.D level in Indian universities. Applications are made online on the ICCR A2A Scholarship Portal and must be submitted through the Indian Mission in the applicant's country, which then forwards them to empanelled Indian State and Central Universities. Registration for the 2026-27 academic year is closed and the portal currently lists 2026-27 as the only registration year.
new_scholarship.program_type: Government scholarship (ICCR administered for the Government of India)
new_scholarship.duration: One year or above for structured courses at UG, PG, Certificate/Diploma and Ph.D levels; a regular Ph.D. student is expected to complete the course within 3 years. Scholarships are paid only for the prescribed duration of the course or until the student leaves India after the final examination, with up to 21 additional days once the university declares the final result.

new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be nationals of Bangladesh, hold a valid passport, and meet the eligibility criteria of the Indian university chosen. ICCR scholarships are only for studies at Indian State and Central Universities, not private or deemed universities. English proficiency is mandatory, and medical-stream courses are not covered.

new_scholarship.official_source: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea
new_scholarship.description: The Global Korea Scholarship is the Republic of Korea's representative government-invited scholarship programme, administered by the National Institute for International Education (NIIED), which invites outstanding students from around the world to study at Korean universities. It funds Korean language training plus associate degree, bachelor's, master's and doctoral degree programmes across more than 80 GKS universities, and also runs an exchange students programme and Korea-Japan exchange programmes. Applicants apply either through their Korean embassy (Embassy Track) or directly to a GKS university (University Track), and the scholarship covers airfare, Korean language training fees, tuition and monthly allowances.
